the-strange.power.adapts-to-any-environm.cost_or_limit: The focus's stated abilities define its specific limits.
the-strange.power.adapts-to-any-environm.who_may: A character choosing this focus; any character type.
the-strange.power.adapts-to-any-environm.combines: A nearby companion who takes no action other than staying next to the adaptor can share adaptive qualities.
the-strange.power.adapts-to-any-environm.blocked_reason: It alters the character's body to function across hostile environmental conditions.

the-strange.power.carries-a-quiver.name: Carries a Quiver

effect.summary: Makes the character a skilled archer, with abilities focused on ranged bow attacks and arrow-making.

the-strange.power.carries-a-quiver.cost_or_limit: Starting equipment includes light armor, a bow, two dozen arrows, another weapon, an explorer's pack, fletching tools, and crowns.
the-strange.power.carries-a-quiver.go_wrong: A connection option may cause an accidental hit on a fellow PC when a bow attack misses.
the-strange.power.carries-a-quiver.who_may: A character choosing this focus, commonly a vector.
the-strange.power.carries-a-quiver.combines: Can use crossbows instead of bows.
the-strange.power.carries-a-quiver.blocked_reason: Its described combat and crafting benefits use ordinary attack and skill rules.

the-strange.power.channels-sinfire.name: Channels Sinfire

effect.summary: Channels sinfire for attacks and sensing sins.

the-strange.power.channels-sinfire.cost_or_limit: Abilities have Intellect costs; weapon imbuement lasts ten minutes.
the-strange.power.channels-sinfire.go_wrong: Sinfire can bring nightmares; others may regard its wielder as demonic, and others’ sins may overwhelm them.
the-strange.power.channels-sinfire.mind: Sinfire can inflict Intellect damage; targets may be dazed or blinded.
the-strange.power.channels-sinfire.who_may: Those able to sense and channel the fire within Ardeyn’s core.
the-strange.power.channels-sinfire.where_from: Ardeyn; associated with Lotan’s fire and the Maker’s will
the-strange.power.channels-sinfire.combines: Can imbue a weapon; sin-sensing can enable long-range attacks against the sensed target.
the-strange.power.channels-sinfire.mechanism: Fire and mental damage, plus sin-sensing
the-strange.power.channels-sinfire.blocked_reason: The described damage and sensing effects fit the basic effect grammar.

the-strange.power.sinfire-touch.name: Sinfire Touch

effect.summary: Flaming hands damage a touched creature with heat or armor-ignoring Intellect harm; alternatively, imbues a weapon with extra fire damage.

the-strange.power.sinfire-touch.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 Intellect point; weapon effect lasts ten minutes
the-strange.power.sinfire-touch.where_from: Sensed in Ardeyn's core and passed through the wielder
the-strange.power.sinfire-touch.blocked_reason: A weapon carries an added damage effect for a limited duration.

the-strange.power.discern-the-sins.name: Discern the Sins

effect.summary: Senses whether a visible nearby creature has committed a significant sin, then permits long-range Sinfire Touch and may reveal a sin's nature after damaging it.

the-strange.power.discern-the-sins.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Intellect points; concentration and sight needed initially; effect lasts one minute
the-strange.power.discern-the-sins.combines: Enables long-range Sinfire Touch against the sensed target
the-strange.power.discern-the-sins.blocked_reason: It detects past wrongdoing and can reveal information about it.

the-strange.power.sinfire-blast.name: Sinfire Blast

effect.summary: Blasts up to three nearby targets with fire or armor-ignoring Intellect damage, with extra targets bought by additional expenditure.

the-strange.power.sinfire-blast.cost_or_limit: Costs at least 3 Intellect points; each extra two points adds a target
the-strange.power.sinfire-blast.combines: Can attack extra targets by spending more points
the-strange.power.sinfire-blast.blocked_reason: The effect attacks several targets in a burst.

effect.summary: Improves defense against compulsion to act against one's wishes.

the-strange.power.certain-punishment.name: Certain Punishment

effect.summary: Once per minute, rerolls a sinfire attack and keeps the better result.

the-strange.power.certain-punishment.blocked_reason: The reroll can be represented as a conditional alteration.

the-strange.power.no-forgiveness.name: No Forgiveness

effect.summary: Increases sinfire damage, including damage from a weapon imbued with sinfire.

the-strange.power.no-forgiveness.mind: Increases Intellect damage as an alternative to heat damage.
the-strange.power.no-forgiveness.blocked_reason: The bonus can be carried by a weapon previously imbued with sinfire.

the-strange.power.conducts-weird-science.name: Conducts Weird Science

effect.summary: Uses experiments to analyze scenes, modify devices, create cyphers, and achieve extraordinary results.

the-strange.power.conducts-weird-science.cost_or_limit: Abilities require Intellect points, time, equipment, and sometimes money or a successful task.
the-strange.power.conducts-weird-science.go_wrong: Creations can escape control; side effects are unpredictable; depleted devices detonate.
the-strange.power.conducts-weird-science.mind: Some creations may daze foes; effects otherwise vary.
the-strange.power.conducts-weird-science.where_from: Earth examples include labs, universities, government, and corporate research.
the-strange.power.conducts-weird-science.combines: A permanent lab improves analysis; science kits and spare parts support device work.
the-strange.power.conducts-weird-science.blocked_reason: Created devices and cyphers can carry special properties and can detonate on depletion.

the-strange.power.lab-analysis.name: Lab Analysis

effect.summary: Analyzes collected samples to discover up to three pertinent facts about a mystery.

the-strange.power.lab-analysis.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; needs samples and takes 2d20 minutes; a permanent lab helps.
the-strange.power.lab-analysis.go_wrong: The GM determines what can be learned and the task difficulty.
the-strange.power.lab-analysis.where_from: A field kit or permanent laboratory
the-strange.power.lab-analysis.combines: A permanent lab makes the task easier than field analysis.
the-strange.power.lab-analysis.blocked_reason: The analysis can reveal hidden information about past events and responsible forces.

the-strange.power.modify-device.name: Modify Device

effect.summary: Temporarily improves tasks performed with jury-rigged equipment until it breaks.

the-strange.power.modify-device.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points, spare parts worth 1d6 × $100, a science kit or lab, a difficulty 3 task, and one hour
the-strange.power.modify-device.go_wrong: Each use has a 1–5 depletion result on a d20; device inevitably breaks
the-strange.power.modify-device.combines: Requires a device and science facilities
the-strange.power.modify-device.blocked_reason: It alters equipment and gives it a breakage and depletion condition.

the-strange.power.better-living-through-.name: Better Living Through Chemistry

effect.summary: An injected tailored drug raises one chosen Edge for a minute.

the-strange.power.better-living-through-.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; cannot benefit again for an hour; point expenditures cost one extra during that hour
the-strange.power.better-living-through-.who_may: The scientist who developed the drug for their own biochemistry
the-strange.power.better-living-through-.combines: Choose Might, Speed, or Intellect Edge
the-strange.power.better-living-through-.blocked_reason: A temporary self-enhancement fits the basic effect grammar.

the-strange.power.weird-science-breakthr.name: Weird Science Breakthrough

effect.summary: Creates a one-use random cypher by capturing a fragment of the Strange in an item.

the-strange.power.weird-science-breakthr.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points, spare parts worth 1d6 × $100, facilities, a difficulty 4 roll; item is usable once and normal cypher limit applies
the-strange.power.weird-science-breakthr.go_wrong: Specified cypher increases difficulty by two steps
the-strange.power.weird-science-breakthr.combines: Improved Weird Science Breakthrough raises maximum cypher level
the-strange.power.weird-science-breakthr.blocked_reason: It creates a cypher that stores a usable power and is limited by cypher capacity.

the-strange.power.incredible-feat-of-sci.name: Incredible Feat of Science

effect.summary: Lab work can achieve extraordinary effects such as reanimation, perpetual motion, opening a gate, transmutation, cures, or exceptional weapons and defenses.

the-strange.power.incredible-feat-of-sci.cost_or_limit: Costs 12 Intellect points, a full day or more, and parts worth 1d6 × $10,000
the-strange.power.incredible-feat-of-sci.combines: Possible outcomes depend on the project
the-strange.power.incredible-feat-of-sci.blocked_reason: Several listed results transform matter or reanimate a body beyond the basic effect grammar.

effect.summary: A deathly visage deals two armor-ignoring damage to a visible living creature.

the-strange.power.law.name: Law

effect.summary: Quoting a relevant law prevents an audible, understanding foe from attacking for one round.

the-strange.power.law.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; foe must hear and understand
the-strange.power.law.blocked_reason: It forces a creature to refrain from attacking.

the-strange.power.mythlight-lance.name: Mythlight Lance

effect.summary: Hurls a short-range lance of divine radiance that damages a target.

the-strange.power.mythlight-lance.blocked_reason: The attack is a direct damage effect.

the-strange.power.sentinel.name: Sentinel

effect.summary: Marks one nearby target with protection for a minute, potentially redirecting attacks away from it.

the-strange.power.sentinel.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; one target marked at a time; lasts one minute
the-strange.power.sentinel.go_wrong: Protection requires a successful Intellect roll when attacked
the-strange.power.sentinel.combines: Attacker must select another target if the roll succeeds
the-strange.power.sentinel.blocked_reason: The effect changes which target an attack can affect.

the-strange.power.arbiter.name: Arbiter

effect.summary: Marks one nearby foe for a minute, making attacks against it easier.

the-strange.power.arbiter.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; one target at a time; lasts one minute

the-strange.power.glory-of-the-divine.name: Glory of the Divine

effect.summary: Assails up to three nearby targets with armor-ignoring Intellect damage, optionally blinding successful targets.

the-strange.power.glory-of-the-divine.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 or more Intellect points; each extra two points adds a target; one additional point can blind hits
the-strange.power.glory-of-the-divine.combines: Additional spending expands targets or adds blindness
the-strange.power.glory-of-the-divine.blocked_reason: It attacks multiple targets in a burst.

the-strange.power.apportation.name: Apportation

effect.summary: Calls ordinary equipment from Ardeyn to the user, or rarely a randomly determined object.

the-strange.power.apportation.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Intellect points; random choice at most daily; cannot take an item held by another creature
the-strange.power.apportation.go_wrong: Random result can be worthless junk
the-strange.power.apportation.combines: Random results may be a cypher, artifact, equipment, or junk
the-strange.power.apportation.blocked_reason: It retrieves objects from a distant location without ordinary travel.

the-strange.power.flight.name: Flight

effect.summary: Grants flight for an hour and can extend it to touched companions, whose movement the user directs.

the-strange.power.flight.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 or more Intellect points; each Effort level affects one additional creature; companions must remain in sight or fall
the-strange.power.flight.blocked_reason: The user directs another creature's movement.

the-strange.power.calm.name: Calm

effect.summary: Damps aggression for up to twelve hours; the target reacts to attacks but does not initiate them.

the-strange.power.calm.who_may: A DNA injector with this secondary effect
the-strange.power.calm.combines: Each injector has only one secondary effect.

the-strange.power.control.name: Control

effect.summary: Touch-based secretions control a low-level creature's actions for a minute, with visible command or case-by-case override.

the-strange.power.control.cost_or_limit: Target level 3 or lower unless Effort raises the limit; user must see target to override control
the-strange.power.control.go_wrong: Target forgets the control and its actions afterward
the-strange.power.control.mind: Controls the target's actions and erases memory of the episode
the-strange.power.control.where_from: Trickery, lies, and mind-affecting skin secretions
the-strange.power.control.combines: Effort can increase maximum target level
the-strange.power.control.mechanism: Temporary mind control with memory suppression
the-strange.power.control.blocked_reason: It directly controls another creature's mind and removes its memory.

the-strange.power.integrates-weaponry.name: Integrates Weaponry

effect.summary: Integrates a usable weapon into the character’s body and grants weapon-related abilities.

the-strange.power.integrates-weaponry.cost_or_limit: An integrated weapon occupies one hand; it adds damage while integrated.
the-strange.power.integrates-weaponry.go_wrong: Weapons can misfire when part of the user’s body.
the-strange.power.integrates-weaponry.mind: Weaponauts are considered to have psychological issues.
the-strange.power.integrates-weaponry.who_may: Weaponauts; commonly vectors, but spinners may choose it.
the-strange.power.integrates-weaponry.where_from: Ruk and adherence to the True Code
the-strange.power.integrates-weaponry.combines: Integrated attacks can visually resemble certain revisions, twists, or moves.
the-strange.power.integrates-weaponry.blocked_reason: The weapon becomes part of the character and carries an ongoing combat bonus.

the-strange.power.golem-grip.name: Golem Grip

effect.summary: A stone-fist hit can hold a target in place and squeeze it for damage each round.

the-strange.power.golem-stomp.name: Golem Stomp

effect.summary: A shock wave damages nearby creatures and either pushes them away or knocks them down.

the-strange.power.golem-stomp.combines: Targets in immediate range take 3 damage.
the-strange.power.golem-stomp.blocked_reason: The stomp affects multiple creatures in an area.

the-strange.power.deep-reserves.name: Deep Reserves

effect.summary: Transfers points among the character's Pools over several rounds.

the-strange.power.deep-reserves.cost_or_limit: Once per day; up to 5 points; one point per round.
the-strange.power.deep-reserves.combines: Points may move among any of the character's Pools in any combination.
the-strange.power.deep-reserves.blocked_reason: The ability transfers points between distinct character resources.

the-strange.power.defend.name: Defend

effect.summary: Grants armor against all attacks, including mental attacks and attacks that normally ignore Armor.

the-strange.power.defend.mind: Protects against mental attacks as well as physical ones.
the-strange.power.defend.who_may: Character with Adapts to Any Environment.
the-strange.power.defend.combines: Applies even when an attack says it ignores Armor.
the-strange.power.defend.blocked_reason: The benefit is a defined Armor increase.

the-strange.power.heal.name: Heal

effect.summary: Adds one point to each recovery roll the character makes.

the-strange.power.heal.who_may: Characters with Adapts to Any Environment
the-strange.power.heal.blocked_reason: The effect is a direct recovery bonus.

the-strange.power.breathe.name: Breathe

effect.summary: Allows safe breathing in any atmosphere or substance, or without an atmosphere.

the-strange.power.breathe.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Might points and lasts one hour.
the-strange.power.breathe.who_may: Characters with Adapts to Any Environment
the-strange.power.breathe.blocked_reason: The effect is a timed bodily protection.

the-strange.power.move.name: Move

effect.summary: Moves the character through any terrain that is not a solid barrier without hindrance.

the-strange.power.move.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Speed points and lasts one hour.
the-strange.power.move.who_may: Characters with Adapts to Any Environment
the-strange.power.move.blocked_reason: The ability grants movement through traversable terrain, not through solid barriers.

the-strange.power.restore.name: Restore

the-strange.power.restore.cost_or_limit: Ten-minute and one-hour recovery periods become one action; ten-hour period becomes one hour; needs one hour of rest daily.
the-strange.power.restore.who_may: Character with Adapts to Any Environment.
the-strange.power.restore.blocked_reason: The effect changes specified recovery and rest durations.

the-strange.power.resist.name: Resist

effect.summary: Provides substantial Armor against environmental damage, including passive hazards.

the-strange.power.resist.cost_or_limit: Special +10 Armor against environmental damage; excludes direct attacks.
the-strange.power.resist.go_wrong: Does not protect against direct attacks.
the-strange.power.resist.who_may: Character with Adapts to Any Environment.
the-strange.power.resist.combines: Covers ambient hazards such as fire, falls, pressure, and acidic mist.
the-strange.power.resist.blocked_reason: The protection has a clear category and excludes direct attacks.

the-strange.power.survive.name: Survive

effect.summary: Adds Armor against all attacks and increases all three stat Pools.

the-strange.power.survive.cost_or_limit: Adds 1 Armor and 3 points to each stat Pool.
the-strange.power.survive.who_may: Character with Adapts to Any Environment.
the-strange.power.survive.combines: Armor applies even to attacks that say they ignore Armor.
the-strange.power.survive.blocked_reason: The benefits are numeric Armor and Pool increases.

the-strange.power.subsist.name: Subsist

effect.summary: Removes the need to eat, drink, or breathe to live.

the-strange.power.subsist.cost_or_limit: Going beyond normal bodily bounds without these needs makes all tasks two steps harder until normal eating, drinking, and breathing resume.
the-strange.power.subsist.go_wrong: Exceeding normal bodily limits imposes a broad task penalty.
the-strange.power.subsist.who_may: Character with Adapts to Any Environment.
the-strange.power.subsist.blocked_reason: The survival rule and its task penalty are explicitly bounded.

the-strange.power.practiced-with-integra.name: Practiced With Integrated Weapons

effect.summary: Removes penalties for using integrated weapons.

the-strange.power.practiced-with-integra.blocked_reason: The stated training benefit is representable as an adjustment to task difficulty.

the-strange.power.weapon-defense.name: Weapon Defense

the-strange.power.weapon-defense.who_may: A character with an integrated weapon.
the-strange.power.weapon-defense.blocked_reason: The defense training benefit is representable in the basic effect grammar.

the-strange.power.trained-integration.name: Trained Integration

effect.summary: Grants training in attacks made with integrated weapons.

the-strange.power.trained-integration.blocked_reason: The training benefit is representable as a task adjustment.

the-strange.power.rapid-attack.name: Rapid Attack

effect.summary: Makes an integrated-weapon attack as part of another action, at increased difficulty.

the-strange.power.rapid-attack.cost_or_limit: Costs 4 Speed points; attack difficulty increases by one step
the-strange.power.rapid-attack.combines: Can add a second attack to an action

the-strange.power.phenomenal-integration.name: Phenomenal Integration

effect.summary: Grants specialization in attacks made with integrated weapons.

the-strange.power.phenomenal-integration.blocked_reason: The specialization benefit is representable as a task adjustment.

the-strange.power.weapon-frenzy.name: Weapon Frenzy

effect.summary: Attacks every creature in range indiscriminately, rolling separately for each.

the-strange.power.weapon-frenzy.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Speed points; ammunition limits attacks
the-strange.power.weapon-frenzy.blocked_reason: It attacks all creatures in range without selecting targets.

the-strange.power.gunner.name: Gunner

effect.summary: Adds one damage to gun attacks.

the-strange.power.gunner.blocked_reason: The damage increase is representable as a basic attack adjustment.

the-strange.power.practiced-with-guns.name: Practiced With Guns

effect.summary: Removes the usual penalty for using guns.

the-strange.power.practiced-with-guns.blocked_reason: Removing an action penalty fits the basic effect grammar.

the-strange.power.careful-shot.name: Careful Shot

effect.summary: Spends Effort from Speed or Intellect to increase successful gun damage, more if the shooter takes time to aim.

the-strange.power.careful-shot.cost_or_limit: Each Effort level adds three damage, or five after a turn spent aiming
the-strange.power.careful-shot.blocked_reason: It modifies damage on a successful attack.

the-strange.power.snapshot.name: Snapshot

effect.summary: Allows two gun attacks in one action, with the second attack made at increased difficulty.

the-strange.power.snapshot.cost_or_limit: The second attack is two steps harder.
the-strange.power.snapshot.blocked_reason: The effect is a pair of ordinary attacks with a difficulty adjustment.

the-strange.power.special-shot.name: Special Shot

effect.summary: Trades one damage for a precise effect such as disarming, impairing movement, or removing worn gear.

the-strange.power.special-shot.who_may: A character hitting with a gun attack.
the-strange.power.special-shot.combines: Combines with a successful gun attack.
the-strange.power.special-shot.blocked_reason: The possible targeted effects vary and include disabling movement or detaching an item.

effect.summary: Grants training in all social interactions.

the-strange.power.good-advice.name: Good Advice

effect.summary: A suggestion makes another character trained in the suggested next action for one round.

the-strange.power.good-advice.combines: Applies to another character's next action
the-strange.power.good-advice.blocked_reason: It grants a short-lived task benefit.

the-strange.power.follower.name: Follower

the-strange.power.follower.mind: The follower is completely devoted to the character.
the-strange.power.follower.combines: A nearby follower provides an asset to one attack on the character’s turn.

the-strange.power.command.name: Command

the-strange.power.command.who_may: A character speaking to a living creature.
the-strange.power.command.blocked_reason: The target is mentally compelled to take an action.

the-strange.power.capable-follower.name: Capable Follower

effect.summary: Raises the first follower's level and associated statistics.

the-strange.power.capable-follower.blocked_reason: It modifies a persistent follower's statistics and capabilities.

the-strange.power.captivate-or-inspire.name: Captivate or Inspire

effect.summary: Words hold listeners' attention while spoken, or improve chosen listening NPCs' level of function for an hour.

the-strange.power.captivate-or-inspire.cost_or_limit: Listeners must hear the speech; captivation lasts only while speaking
the-strange.power.captivate-or-inspire.blocked_reason: It manipulates the attention and performance of multiple NPCs.

the-strange.power.band-of-followers.name: Band of Followers

the-strange.power.band-of-followers.combines: Adds to the follower gained at tier two
the-strange.power.band-of-followers.blocked_reason: It adds multiple persistent devoted NPC followers.

the-strange.power.mind-of-a-leader.name: Mind of a Leader

the-strange.power.mind-of-a-leader.blocked_reason: It reveals likely future consequences of a proposed plan.

the-strange.power.capable-followers.name: Capable Followers

effect.summary: Raises the original follower to level five and the tier-two followers to level three.

the-strange.power.capable-followers.combines: Improves Follower and Band of Followers
the-strange.power.capable-followers.blocked_reason: It modifies the statistics of persistent allied NPCs.

the-strange.power.wilderness-life.name: Wilderness Life

effect.summary: Grants training in climbing and swimming.

the-strange.power.wilderness-life.cost_or_limit: Applies to climbing and swimming tasks.
the-strange.power.wilderness-life.blocked_reason: The training benefit is representable as a task adjustment.

the-strange.power.wilderness-lore.name: Wilderness Lore

effect.summary: Grants training in wilderness navigation and identifying plants and creatures.

the-strange.power.wilderness-lore.cost_or_limit: Applies to wilderness navigation and identification.
the-strange.power.wilderness-lore.blocked_reason: The training benefit is representable as a task adjustment.

the-strange.power.living-off-the-land.name: Living Off the Land

effect.summary: Finds edible food and potable water for the user or a small group; also improves resistance to natural poisons and grants immunity to natural disease.

the-strange.power.living-off-the-land.cost_or_limit: Requires about an hour in wilderness
the-strange.power.living-off-the-land.combines: Food and water can supply a small group
the-strange.power.living-off-the-land.blocked_reason: The ability grants ordinary survival resources and resistance.

the-strange.power.animal-senses-and-sens.name: Animal Senses and Sensibilities

effect.summary: Grants training in listening and spotting and warns of lower-level nearby ambushes or traps.

the-strange.power.animal-senses-and-sens.cost_or_limit: Warning applies to traps and ambushes below level three
the-strange.power.animal-senses-and-sens.combines: GM warning is usually given before danger
the-strange.power.animal-senses-and-sens.blocked_reason: It can alert the user to concealed future danger.

the-strange.power.wilderness-explorer.name: Wilderness Explorer

effect.summary: Ignores penalties caused by natural wilderness conditions while acting there.

the-strange.power.question-the-spirits.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Intellect points; usually no more than three questions. Requires personal acquaintance, an owned object plus full name, or physical remains.
the-strange.power.question-the-spirits.go_wrong: The spirit can refuse or lack the information; the caller may need to persuade or wrestle it.
the-strange.power.question-the-spirits.mind: The caller can try to psychically subdue the spirit.
the-strange.power.question-the-spirits.where_from: Ardeyn dead, reached through the Night Vault
the-strange.power.question-the-spirits.combines: The spirit may appear as a shade, inhabit an object or remains, or be an invisible presence.
the-strange.power.question-the-spirits.mechanism: Summoning and questioning a dead spirit
the-strange.power.question-the-spirits.blocked_reason: The ability summons and interacts with a dead soul, a capability beyond basic information sensing.

the-strange.power.spirit-accomplice.name: Spirit Accomplice

effect.summary: A level 3 Ardeyn spirit accompanies the character and follows instructions.

the-strange.power.spirit-accomplice.cost_or_limit: Must stay within immediate distance or fade at the end of the character’s next turn; cannot return for a day. It occupies a designated object and specializes in one knowledge skill.
the-strange.power.spirit-accomplice.go_wrong: If destroyed, it reforms in 1d6 days, or a replacement can be attracted in 2d6 days.
the-strange.power.spirit-accomplice.mind: It is an instructed companion with its own knowledge specialty.
the-strange.power.spirit-accomplice.where_from: A dead human, qephilim, or other Ardeyn creature
the-strange.power.spirit-accomplice.combines: Acts on the character’s turn; can move through walls while insubstantial and help with an attack when substantial.
the-strange.power.spirit-accomplice.blocked_reason: Creating and retaining a summoned spirit companion requires a familiar-summoning capability.

the-strange.power.command-the-dead.name: Command the Dead

effect.summary: On success, a nearby spirit or animated dead creature cannot attack the user and follows audible, understood verbal commands.

the-strange.power.command-the-dead.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; target is at most level 5 and within short range; lasts one minute.
the-strange.power.command-the-dead.go_wrong: The command fails if the task is unsuccessful.
the-strange.power.command-the-dead.mind: Restricts the target’s actions and directs its behavior.
the-strange.power.command-the-dead.combines: Improved Command the Dead raises the maximum target level to 7.
the-strange.power.command-the-dead.blocked_reason: Preventing attacks and compelling obedience requires mind-binding.

the-strange.power.wraith-cloak.name: Wraith Cloak

effect.summary: The accomplice wraps around the user, damaging those who touch or melee-strike them and helping them evade notice.

the-strange.power.wraith-cloak.who_may: A character with a Spirit Accomplice
the-strange.power.wraith-cloak.combines: Deals 4 damage to a toucher or melee attacker; decreases the difficulty of evading perception by one step.
the-strange.power.wraith-cloak.blocked_reason: The sustained protective aura and its contact-triggered damage need a field effect.

the-strange.power.call-dead-spirit.name: Call Dead Spirit

effect.summary: Makes a creature dead no longer than seven days appear as a manifest, apparently physical spirit.

the-strange.power.call-dead-spirit.cost_or_limit: Costs 6 Intellect points; lasts up to a day, or less if the spirit completes something important; cannot be called again afterward.
the-strange.power.call-dead-spirit.go_wrong: The spirit may fade earlier; it is not bound to obey or stay nearby.
the-strange.power.call-dead-spirit.mind: The raised spirit retains its memories and former abilities.
the-strange.power.call-dead-spirit.combines: The spirit can become insubstantial as an action for up to a minute.
the-strange.power.call-dead-spirit.blocked_reason: Manifesting a dead person while preserving its identity and memories requires soul-state handling.

the-strange.power.umber-judge.name: Umber Judge

effect.summary: On killing an unprotected creature, pulls out its spirit, draws some soul energy to restore a chosen Pool, and imprisons the spirit in a hidden Night Vault cell.

the-strange.power.umber-judge.cost_or_limit: Requires killing the creature with an attack; the spirit must be unprotected.
the-strange.power.umber-judge.go_wrong: The spirit cannot be questioned, raised, or restored unless the user permits it.
the-strange.power.umber-judge.where_from: The victim’s spirit and the Night Vault
the-strange.power.umber-judge.combines: Restores 1d6 points to one chosen Pool.
the-strange.power.umber-judge.mechanism: Soul extraction, resource recovery, and hidden imprisonment
the-strange.power.umber-judge.blocked_reason: Extracting, imprisoning, and controlling the restoration of souls requires soul-state handling.

the-strange.power.improved-command-the-d.name: Improved Command the Dead

effect.summary: Raises the maximum undead level affected by Command the Dead.

the-strange.power.improved-command-the-d.cost_or_limit: Command the Dead can affect undead up to level seven.
the-strange.power.improved-command-the-d.mind: The target is subject to Command the Dead’s compulsion.
the-strange.power.improved-command-the-d.blocked_reason: It extends an ability that compels a target’s behavior.

the-strange.power.slays-dragons.name: SLAYS DRAGONS

effect.summary: Trains and empowers the character to fight dragons and other large creatures.

the-strange.power.slays-dragons.cost_or_limit: Specific abilities have their own conditions and costs.
the-strange.power.slays-dragons.who_may: Characters with this focus, commonly vectors.
the-strange.power.slays-dragons.combines: Can pair with vector, spinner, or paradox capabilities.
the-strange.power.slays-dragons.blocked_reason: The abilities are combat and defense benefits.

the-strange.power.dragon-sword.name: Dragon Sword

effect.summary: Grants practice with greatswords and lances.

the-strange.power.dragon-sword.blocked_reason: Weapon training is not an effect requiring a special grammar capability.

the-strange.power.dragon-bane.cost_or_limit: Adds 1 damage generally and 3 against sufficiently large creatures.
the-strange.power.dragon-bane.combines: Improved and Heroic Dragon Bane retain the stated large-target bonus.
the-strange.power.dragon-bane.blocked_reason: A conditional damage bonus fits the basic effect grammar.

the-strange.power.dragon-lore.name: Dragon Lore

effect.summary: Provides training in Ardeyn dragon lore and the ability to make oneself understood in the dragon language.

the-strange.power.dragon-lore.blocked_reason: Knowledge and communication fit the basic effect grammar.

the-strange.power.will-of-legend.name: Will of Legend

effect.summary: Prevents attacks that would captivate, mesmerize, charm, or otherwise influence the user’s mind.

the-strange.power.will-of-legend.mind: Protects the user from mental influence.
the-strange.power.will-of-legend.blocked_reason: Blocking a range of incoming powers requires explicit power-interaction handling.

the-strange.power.trained-slayer.name: Trained Slayer

effect.summary: Grants training with greatswords and lances.

the-strange.power.trained-slayer.blocked_reason: Weapon training is not an effect requiring a special grammar capability.

the-strange.power.improved-dragon-bane.name: Improved Dragon Bane

effect.summary: Adds extra damage against creatures more than twice the user’s size.

the-strange.power.improved-dragon-bane.cost_or_limit: Adds three damage against such creatures.
the-strange.power.improved-dragon-bane.combines: Improves Dragon Bane’s damage against large targets.
the-strange.power.improved-dragon-bane.blocked_reason: The effect adds damage to attacks.

the-strange.power.rider.name: Rider

effect.summary: Grants training in riding any creature used as a mount in Ardeyn.

the-strange.power.rider.blocked_reason: Training is not an effect requiring a special grammar capability.

the-strange.power.fight-on.name: Fight On

effect.summary: Removes impairment penalties and allows action while debilitated, though tasks then become harder.

the-strange.power.fight-on.cost_or_limit: While debilitated, all task difficulties increase by one step.
the-strange.power.fight-on.blocked_reason: The rule modifies the character’s available actions and task difficulty.

the-strange.power.specialized-slayer.name: Specialized Slayer

effect.summary: Grants specialization with greatswords and lances.

the-strange.power.specialized-slayer.blocked_reason: Training is not an effect requiring a special grammar capability.

the-strange.power.heroic-dragon-bane.name: Heroic Dragon Bane

effect.summary: Adds extra damage against creatures more than twice the user’s size.

the-strange.power.heroic-dragon-bane.cost_or_limit: Adds three damage against such creatures.
the-strange.power.heroic-dragon-bane.blocked_reason: The effect adds damage to attacks.

the-strange.power.slayer.name: Slayer

effect.summary: Adds 3 damage when attacking with a greatsword or lance.

the-strange.power.slayer.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 Might points; applies regardless of target.
the-strange.power.slayer.combines: Stacks with the large-target Dragon Bane bonus as described.
the-strange.power.slayer.blocked_reason: A weapon-based damage bonus fits the basic effect grammar.

the-strange.power.investigator.name: Investigator

effect.summary: Allows Effort on Intellect tasks to draw points from any of the user’s Pools.

the-strange.power.investigator.cost_or_limit: Can spend Might, Speed, or Intellect points to apply Effort.
the-strange.power.investigator.go_wrong: Spending points depletes the chosen Pool.
the-strange.power.investigator.blocked_reason: The ability changes which Pool may pay for Effort.

the-strange.power.sleuth.name: Sleuth

effect.summary: Grants training in perception.

the-strange.power.sleuth.blocked_reason: Training is not an effect requiring a special grammar capability.

the-strange.power.out-of-harm-s-way.name: Out of Harm’s Way

effect.summary: Grants training in Speed defense tasks.

the-strange.power.out-of-harm-s-way.blocked_reason: Training is not an effect requiring a special grammar capability.

the-strange.power.you-studied.name: You Studied

effect.summary: Grants training in two chosen knowledge areas or specialization in one.

the-strange.power.you-studied.cost_or_limit: Choices cannot be physical actions or combat-related.
the-strange.power.you-studied.blocked_reason: Training is not an effect requiring a special grammar capability.

the-strange.power.draw-conclusion.name: Draw Conclusion

effect.summary: After investigation lasting minutes, reveals a pertinent fact.

the-strange.power.draw-conclusion.cost_or_limit: Costs 3 Intellect points; difficulty 3, rising one step per repeated use until a ten-hour rest resets it.
the-strange.power.draw-conclusion.combines: Requires activity such as questioning people or searching an area or file.

the-strange.power.diffuse-situation.name: Diffuse Situation

the-strange.power.diffuse-situation.cost_or_limit: Limited to a living foe during an investigation.

the-strange.power.seize-the-initiative.name: Seize the Initiative

effect.summary: Grants one additional immediate action after a successful Draw Conclusion.

the-strange.power.spawns.name: Spawns

the-strange.power.spawns.mind: Clones may become conscious and autonomous.

the-strange.power.friend-in-yourself.name: Friend in Yourself

effect.summary: Provides a level 2 clone that follows the user’s instructions and helps with one nearby attack.

the-strange.power.friend-in-yourself.cost_or_limit: A clone’s death takes 1d6 days to replace; normally only one active clone.
the-strange.power.friend-in-yourself.go_wrong: The clone can die; the bond limits active clones.
the-strange.power.friend-in-yourself.mind: The clone thinks through a subtle psychic bond.
the-strange.power.friend-in-yourself.combines: Adjacent clone serves as an asset for one attack on the user’s turn.
the-strange.power.friend-in-yourself.blocked_reason: The ability creates and maintains a companion creature.

the-strange.power.psychic-bond.name: Psychic Bond

effect.summary: Enables telepathic communication with the clone across the same recursion and lets the user sense its perceptions.

the-strange.power.psychic-bond.cost_or_limit: Sensing perceptions requires an action and lasts until the user’s next turn; communication is limited to the same recursion.
the-strange.power.psychic-bond.mind: Creates telepathic communication between clone and user.
the-strange.power.psychic-bond.combines: Works between the user and their clone.

the-strange.power.helpful-clone.name: Helpful Clone

effect.summary: A clone’s help reduces the difficulty of its creator’s task by one step, even when the clone lacks training.

the-strange.power.helpful-clone.cost_or_limit: The clone must spend its action helping.
the-strange.power.helpful-clone.who_may: A character with this focus and a clone.
the-strange.power.helpful-clone.combines: Requires the clone to help with the task.
the-strange.power.helpful-clone.blocked_reason: A task-difficulty adjustment is a basic effect.

the-strange.power.covering-clone.name: Covering Clone

effect.summary: A nearby clone provides cover, reducing the difficulty of its creator’s Speed defense; an otherwise successful attack hits the clone instead.

the-strange.power.covering-clone.cost_or_limit: The clone must stand next to the character.
the-strange.power.covering-clone.go_wrong: The clone takes attacks redirected from its creator.
the-strange.power.covering-clone.mind: The clone prioritizes its creator’s well-being.
the-strange.power.covering-clone.who_may: A character with this focus and a clone.
the-strange.power.covering-clone.combines: Uses the clone’s position to protect the character.
the-strange.power.covering-clone.blocked_reason: The protection and attack redirection can be represented as blocking and changing a target.

the-strange.power.improved-clone.name: Improved Clone

effect.summary: Raises the clone’s level to 4, with corresponding increases to target number, health, and damage.

the-strange.power.improved-clone.cost_or_limit: The improved clone has target number 12, health 12, and damage 4.
the-strange.power.improved-clone.blocked_reason: Changing a companion’s numerical ratings is representable as an alteration.

the-strange.power.force-spawning.name: Force Spawning

effect.summary: Rapidly creates a temporary level 3 clone, even when other clones are active.

the-strange.power.force-spawning.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Might points; user is pushed one damage-track step until the next recovery roll; clone lasts one minute.
the-strange.power.force-spawning.go_wrong: The clone expires and slumps like melting wax.
the-strange.power.force-spawning.mind: The clone is another copy of the user.
the-strange.power.force-spawning.combines: Can exceed the ordinary active-clone limit.
the-strange.power.force-spawning.blocked_reason: The ability creates an additional temporary companion creature.

the-strange.power.psychic-transfer.name: Psychic Transfer

effect.summary: Switches the user’s mind and clone’s mind between their bodies, with the option to make the change permanent or switch back.

the-strange.power.psychic-transfer.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Intellect points; requires a clone within long range and an action.
the-strange.power.psychic-transfer.mind: Exchanges minds between the user and clone.
the-strange.power.psychic-transfer.who_may: A character with this focus and a clone.
the-strange.power.psychic-transfer.combines: Uses the psychic bond; can be reversed with a separate action.
the-strange.power.psychic-transfer.blocked_reason: Moving minds between bodies and making the exchange permanent requires mind-transfer rules.

the-strange.power.translates.name: TRANSLATES

the-strange.power.translates.who_may: A character who has translated at least once.
the-strange.power.translates.where_from: Chosen in a recursion the character translates to.
the-strange.power.translates.combines: Requires prior translation; grants recursion-related abilities.
the-strange.power.translates.blocked_reason: This is a focus heading, not a standalone effect.

the-strange.power.recursion-treader.cost_or_limit: One item, small enough to carry in one hand.
the-strange.power.recursion-treader.go_wrong: The translated item may lose practical usefulness in its new context.
the-strange.power.recursion-treader.who_may: A character with the Translates focus.
the-strange.power.recursion-treader.combines: Works during translation; the GM determines the new context-appropriate form.
the-strange.power.recursion-treader.blocked_reason: Moving and transforming one carried item can be represented with position and form effects.

the-strange.power.recursion-lore.name: Recursion Lore

effect.summary: Grants training in general knowledge about Ruk, Ardeyn, or another chosen recursion besides Earth.

the-strange.power.recursion-lore.who_may: A character with the Translates focus.
the-strange.power.recursion-lore.combines: Knowledge concerns the chosen recursion’s people, creatures, threats, and lands.
the-strange.power.recursion-lore.blocked_reason: The ability grants information and training.

the-strange.power.improved-reach-beyond.name: Improved Reach Beyond

effect.summary: Reduces the Intellect cost of the type ability Reach Beyond to one point.

the-strange.power.improved-reach-beyond.who_may: A character with the Translates focus.
the-strange.power.improved-reach-beyond.combines: Modifies Reach Beyond, whose description is elsewhere.
the-strange.power.improved-reach-beyond.blocked_reason: The passage does not describe what Reach Beyond does.

the-strange.power.translation-savant.name: Translation Savant

the-strange.power.master-of-form.where_from: A focus the character had in the past.

the-strange.power.wields-two-weapons-at-.combines: Wuxia examples include nunchaku and sais.

the-strange.rule.still-as-a-statue.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 Might points; normally ends after a day, or earlier if a trusted ally shakes the golem hard enough and spends at least 2 Might points.
the-strange.rule.still-as-a-statue.go_wrong: The golem cannot sense events or act physically while frozen.
the-strange.rule.still-as-a-statue.mind: No time seems to pass for the golem.
the-strange.rule.still-as-a-statue.where_from: Sorcerous energy drawn into the stone core
the-strange.rule.still-as-a-statue.combines: An ally can rouse the golem early.
the-strange.rule.still-as-a-statue.blocked_reason: The user experiences no passing time while immobilized until a delayed or externally triggered awakening.

the-strange.rule.integrated-weapon-hand-.name: Integrated weapon hand restriction

effect.summary: Two integrated weapons prevent hand-dependent tasks and limit the user to one attack with an integrated weapon per turn.

the-strange.rule.integrated-weapon-hand-.cost_or_limit: Applies while two weapons are integrated.
the-strange.rule.integrated-weapon-hand-.combines: A single integrated weapon can be integrated or removed with an action.
the-strange.rule.integrated-weapon-hand-.blocked_reason: The rule limits available actions and attacks.

the-strange.rule.metamorph-target-select.name: Metamorph target selection and backlash

effect.summary: A chrysalid user cannot spend Intellect freely, attacks the nearest or largest living creature in short range, and suffers penalties after reverting.

the-strange.rule.metamorph-target-select.cost_or_limit: The post-transformation penalty lasts an hour, or a day at greater severity if no real enemy was defeated.
the-strange.rule.metamorph-target-select.go_wrong: Allies and bystanders may be attacked; the user may suffer lingering penalties.
the-strange.rule.metamorph-target-select.mind: The user’s target choice becomes involuntary.
the-strange.rule.metamorph-target-select.blocked_reason: The rule ties mandatory targeting and backlash to a transformed body.

the-strange.rule.phylactery-destruction-.name: Phylactery destruction and rebuilding

effect.summary: Destroying the phylactery returns the soul to the body and ends its benefits until a replacement is made.

the-strange.rule.phylactery-destruction-.cost_or_limit: Replacement takes a day and requires a ring or amulet worth at least 100 crowns; Pool maxima are reduced by one in the interim.
the-strange.rule.phylactery-destruction-.go_wrong: Loss of the phylactery removes its protections.
the-strange.rule.phylactery-destruction-.blocked_reason: It governs the location and return of a character’s soul.

the-strange.rule.clothed-spirit-duration.name: Clothed spirit duration and damage

effect.summary: A clothed spirit returns to its housing item after an hour or when its vessel takes six damage.

the-strange.rule.clothed-spirit-duration.cost_or_limit: A sleeping living vessel wakes with six damage.
the-strange.rule.clothed-spirit-duration.go_wrong: The vessel may be harmed and awakened.
the-strange.rule.clothed-spirit-duration.mind: A living vessel retains no clear memory of the spirit’s presence.
the-strange.rule.clothed-spirit-duration.combines: The spirit returns to jewelry or tattoo housing.
the-strange.rule.clothed-spirit-duration.blocked_reason: It governs a spirit’s residence in and departure from a body.

the-strange.rule.soul-river-escalation.name: Soul River escalation

effect.summary: Each Soul River attempt before rest raises its difficulty by one step, resetting after ten hours.

the-strange.rule.soul-river-escalation.cost_or_limit: Difficulty begins at 4 and increases per attempt.
the-strange.rule.soul-river-escalation.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward difficulty increase and reset.

the-strange.rule.escape-the-vault-annual.name: Escape the Vault annual limit

effect.summary: Either form of Escape the Vault can be used only once per year.

the-strange.rule.escape-the-vault-annual.cost_or_limit: A later death before the year passes sends the spirit to the Court of Sleep.
the-strange.rule.escape-the-vault-annual.go_wrong: The spirit may be taken by the Court of Sleep.
the-strange.rule.escape-the-vault-annual.combines: The limit is shared by self-return and returning another soul.
the-strange.rule.escape-the-vault-annual.blocked_reason: It governs post-death outcomes and soul destination.

the-strange.rule.regeneration-difficulty.name: Regeneration difficulty reset

effect.summary: Repeated self-regeneration attempts become harder until a ten-hour rest resets the difficulty.

the-strange.rule.regeneration-difficulty.cost_or_limit: The first use has difficulty 2; each further use raises it by one step.
the-strange.rule.regeneration-difficulty.who_may: Users of Regeneration and Greater Regeneration.
the-strange.rule.regeneration-difficulty.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward difficulty increase and reset.

the-strange.rule.transplanted-regenerati.name: Transplanted regeneration difficulty reset

effect.summary: Each treatment of the same creature becomes harder until that creature rests for ten hours.

the-strange.rule.transplanted-regenerati.cost_or_limit: Difficulty begins at 3 and increases with each attempt on the same recipient.
the-strange.rule.transplanted-regenerati.combines: Applies to one recipient at a time.
the-strange.rule.transplanted-regenerati.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward difficulty increase and reset.

the-strange.rule.spirit-accomplice-refor.name: Spirit accomplice reformation

effect.summary: A destroyed spirit accomplice reforms after 1d6 days; attracting a replacement takes 2d6 days.

the-strange.rule.spirit-accomplice-refor.blocked_reason: Reformation after destruction requires persistent spirit identity and recovery.

the-strange.rule.active-clone-limit.name: Active clone limit

effect.summary: The psychic bond normally limits a character to one active clone at a time, though Force Spawning can exceed that limit.

the-strange.rule.active-clone-limit.mind: The clone’s thinking is linked to the psychic bond.
the-strange.rule.active-clone-limit.combines: Force Spawning overrides the normal limit.
the-strange.rule.active-clone-limit.blocked_reason: A cap on simultaneously active companions can be implemented as a game limit.

the-strange.rule.translation-focus-eligi.name: Translation focus eligibility

effect.summary: A character can choose Translates only after translating at least once.

the-strange.rule.translation-focus-eligi.cost_or_limit: Not selectable at character creation, regardless of origin.
the-strange.rule.translation-focus-eligi.combines: Can be adopted in any recursion after translation.
the-strange.rule.translation-focus-eligi.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward character-option restriction.

the-strange.rule.equipment-does-not-tran.name: Equipment does not translate

effect.summary: Ordinary equipment is replaced with equivalent local gear during translation; only cyphers and rare Strange-based artifacts travel between recursions.

the-strange.rule.equipment-does-not-tran.cost_or_limit: Cyphers and Strange-linked artifacts are exceptions and adapt to the new context.
the-strange.rule.equipment-does-not-tran.go_wrong: Ordinary carried gear does not persist across translation.
the-strange.rule.equipment-does-not-tran.combines: Cyphers retain their effect even when their form changes.
the-strange.rule.equipment-does-not-tran.blocked_reason: The rule distinguishes which items persist and how their forms change during translation.

the-strange.rule.encumbrance-methods.name: Encumbrance methods

effect.summary: Excess load is handled either as a Might task for a brief lift or as ongoing Speed and Might costs.

the-strange.rule.encumbrance-methods.cost_or_limit: The GM chooses the method based on the load’s duration.
the-strange.rule.encumbrance-methods.combines: Long-term load reduces Speed immediately until unburdened and costs Might each hour.
the-strange.rule.encumbrance-methods.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure rather than a missing effect capability.

the-strange.rule.encumbrance-recovery.name: Encumbrance recovery

effect.summary: The Speed loss from long-term encumbrance remains until the burden is removed; ongoing Might costs are recovered normally.

the-strange.rule.encumbrance-recovery.cost_or_limit: Speed and Might costs are equal, in increments of 1, 2, or 3 points.
the-strange.rule.encumbrance-recovery.go_wrong: Rest cannot restore the encumbrance-related Speed loss while the burden remains.
the-strange.rule.encumbrance-recovery.combines: Armor has a similar cost and penalty structure.
the-strange.rule.encumbrance-recovery.mechanism: Persistent Pool penalty and hourly resource drain
the-strange.rule.encumbrance-recovery.blocked_reason: This is a resource-cost and recovery rule.

the-strange.rule.armor-stacking.name: Armor stacking

effect.summary: A character may wear only one armor type, but Armor bonuses from different sources add together.

the-strange.rule.armor-stacking.cost_or_limit: Only one worn armor type at a time.
the-strange.rule.armor-stacking.combines: Armor bonuses from separate sources combine.
the-strange.rule.armor-stacking.blocked_reason: This is a direct equipment-stacking rule.

the-strange.rule.armor-costs.name: Armor costs

effect.summary: Wearing armor costs Might hourly and reduces Speed while worn; Might recovers normally, while Speed returns when armor is removed.

the-strange.rule.armor-costs.cost_or_limit: Light: 1 Might per hour and 2 Speed; medium: 2 Might per hour and 3 Speed; heavy: 3 Might per hour and 5 Speed.
the-strange.rule.armor-costs.go_wrong: The Speed reduction persists while the armor remains worn.
the-strange.rule.armor-costs.combines: Abilities may reduce these costs and penalties.
the-strange.rule.armor-costs.mechanism: Hourly resource drain and persistent Pool reduction
the-strange.rule.armor-costs.blocked_reason: The rule specifies costs and conditional recovery.

the-strange.rule.unpracticed-weapon-use.name: Unpracticed weapon use

effect.summary: Attacking with a weapon the character is not practiced with increases task difficulty by one step.

the-strange.rule.unpracticed-weapon-use.cost_or_limit: Applies when the user lacks at least practice with that weapon.
the-strange.rule.unpracticed-weapon-use.combines: Vectors generally know most weapon types; spinners and paradoxes tend to favor lighter weapons.
the-strange.rule.unpracticed-weapon-use.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward task-difficulty rule.

the-strange.rule.light-weapon-damage.name: Light weapon damage

effect.summary: Light weapons deal 2 damage and reduce attack difficulty by one step.

the-strange.rule.light-weapon-damage.combines: Examples include punches, kicks, knives, handaxes, and .22 pistols.

the-strange.rule.medium-weapon-damage.name: Medium weapon damage

effect.summary: Medium weapons deal 4 damage.

the-strange.rule.medium-weapon-damage.cost_or_limit: Most one-handed weapons are medium; the .22 rifle is also medium.
the-strange.rule.medium-weapon-damage.combines: Examples include katanas, nightsticks, and 9mm pistols.

the-strange.rule.heavy-weapon-damage.name: Heavy weapon damage

effect.summary: Heavy weapons deal 6 damage and require two hands to attack.

the-strange.rule.heavy-weapon-damage.combines: Examples include huge swords, heavy pistols, shotguns, and high-caliber rifles.

the-strange.rule.item-quality-by-recursi.name: Item quality by recursion

effect.summary: An item’s potential quality depends on local industrial or magical material capability, but advanced infrastructure does not guarantee high quality.

the-strange.rule.item-quality-by-recursi.cost_or_limit: Mass production, cheap materials, and planned obsolescence can lower quality.
the-strange.rule.item-quality-by-recursi.go_wrong: A high-tech or high-magic setting may still produce low-quality goods.
the-strange.rule.item-quality-by-recursi.where_from: The recursion’s material arts, sciences, and industrial infrastructure
the-strange.rule.item-quality-by-recursi.combines: Examples contrast Earth nylon rope and doors with Ardeyn hemp rope and oak doors.
the-strange.rule.item-quality-by-recursi.blocked_reason: This rule describes how equipment quality is assigned.

the-strange.rule.artifact-depletion.name: Artifact depletion

effect.summary: An artifact may stop working permanently when its depletion roll matches its listed number.

the-strange.rule.artifact-depletion.cost_or_limit: Use triggers a roll of the specified die; a dash means no depletion and automatic means one use.
the-strange.rule.artifact-depletion.go_wrong: A depleted artifact is expended, though some may be recharged.
the-strange.rule.artifact-depletion.combines: Repair rules or special abilities can sometimes restore use.
the-strange.rule.artifact-depletion.blocked_reason: The rules require an item state that records depletion and possible recharging.

the-strange.rule.artifacts-across-recurs.name: Artifacts across recursions

effect.summary: An artifact can keep working in a destination with its origin’s law, but degrades after about a minute under a different law.

the-strange.rule.artifacts-across-recurs.cost_or_limit: Requires travel through an inapposite gate for the stated movement.
the-strange.rule.artifacts-across-recurs.go_wrong: Power begins to degrade in a recursion governed by a different law.
the-strange.rule.artifacts-across-recurs.combines: Depends on the laws of the artifact’s origin and destination.
the-strange.rule.artifacts-across-recurs.blocked_reason: The rule can be modeled as delayed alteration based on destination law.

the-strange.rule.ruk-currency-and-the-al.name: Ruk currency and the All Song

effect.summary: Ruk accounts are virtual and monitored through the All Song; transactions add to and subtract from accounts.

the-strange.rule.ruk-currency-and-the-al.cost_or_limit: Transactions require access to the All Song.
the-strange.rule.ruk-currency-and-the-al.combines: Accounts and transactions are mediated by the All Song.
the-strange.rule.ruk-currency-and-the-al.blocked_reason: Account balances can be represented as information changes made through a network.

the-strange.rule.npc-health-and-damage.name: NPC health and damage

effect.summary: NPC damage is deducted from health; zero health means dead or incapacitated.

the-strange.rule.npc-health-and-damage.cost_or_limit: An NPC’s health normally equals its target number.
the-strange.rule.npc-health-and-damage.combines: Objects also use health and are broken or destroyed at zero.
the-strange.rule.npc-health-and-damage.blocked_reason: The health and zero-state mechanism is directly usable.

the-strange.rule.armor-reduces-damage.name: Armor reduces damage

effect.summary: Armor is subtracted from incoming damage before it reduces health or a stat pool.

the-strange.rule.armor-reduces-damage.cost_or_limit: Speed, Intellect, and usually ambient damage ignore armor.
the-strange.rule.armor-reduces-damage.combines: Armor from equipment and abilities can add together.
the-strange.rule.armor-reduces-damage.blocked_reason: The reduction and exceptions are stated clearly.

the-strange.rule.damage-overflow.name: Damage overflow

effect.summary: Further damage to a stat at zero shifts to the next available stat pool.

the-strange.rule.damage-overflow.cost_or_limit: Overflow follows Might, Speed, then Intellect; it keeps its original damage type for armor and ability interactions.
the-strange.rule.damage-overflow.combines: A character reaching zero in a stat also moves down the damage track.
the-strange.rule.damage-overflow.blocked_reason: The pool order and damage-type handling are explicit.

the-strange.rule.damage-track.name: Damage track

effect.summary: Reaching zero in a stat moves a character through impaired and debilitated toward death.

the-strange.rule.damage-track.cost_or_limit: The states are hale, impaired, debilitated, and dead; recovery can move a character upward.
the-strange.rule.damage-track.combines: Special effects may shift a character down the track directly.
the-strange.rule.damage-track.blocked_reason: The states and transition trigger are given.

the-strange.rule.recovery-rolls.name: Recovery rolls

effect.summary: A game procedure for recovering stat-pool points by resting.

the-strange.rule.recovery-rolls.cost_or_limit: The die result plus tier sets points recovered; later rests that day require progressively longer rests.
the-strange.rule.recovery-rolls.combines: Recovered points can be allocated across stat pools.
the-strange.rule.recovery-rolls.blocked_reason: This is game procedure, not a world entity.

the-strange.rule.artificial-afterlife.name: artificial afterlife

effect.summary: In Ardeyn and possibly other recursions, a character may be brought back from an artificial afterlife.

the-strange.rule.artificial-afterlife.cost_or_limit: Options may exist only in some recursions.
the-strange.rule.artificial-afterlife.who_may: a dead character, if an option is available
the-strange.rule.artificial-afterlife.combines: May allow a return after death.
the-strange.rule.artificial-afterlife.blocked_reason: The passage mentions return from an afterlife but does not specify how a soul state is represented or restored.

the-strange.rule.translation-is-not-tele.name: Translation is not teleportation

effect.summary: none

the-strange.rule.translation-is-not-tele.blocked_reason: The rule distinguishes a consciousness transfer into a new body from physical travel.

the-strange.rule.translation-time.name: Translation time

effect.summary: none

the-strange.rule.translation-time.cost_or_limit: A four-hour trance precedes instant translation; cooperation can shorten it.
the-strange.rule.translation-time.blocked_reason: The basic grammar can represent an instantaneous transfer following a time limit.

the-strange.rule.translation-acclimation.name: Translation acclimation

effect.summary: Temporarily prevents access to relevant focus abilities after translation.

the-strange.rule.translation-acclimation.cost_or_limit: Can last from one round to an hour, depending on circumstances.
the-strange.rule.translation-acclimation.blocked_reason: A temporary restriction on using abilities can be represented as blocking a working.

the-strange.rule.translation-failure.name: Translation failure

effect.summary: A failed translation can produce no travel, an altered destination, or various temporary and lasting penalties.

the-strange.rule.translation-failure.cost_or_limit: The result is determined by a roll on the failure table.
the-strange.rule.translation-failure.go_wrong: May include memory loss, impaired tasks, dangerous destinations, or arrival in another recursion.
the-strange.rule.translation-failure.mind: Some outcomes confuse characters or erase a period of memory.
the-strange.rule.translation-failure.combines: A retry is possible, but requires Effort.
the-strange.rule.translation-failure.blocked_reason: Several failure results impose lasting impairment or memory loss beyond the basic effect grammar.

the-strange.rule.warded-locations.name: Warded locations

effect.summary: A ward can make translation into or out of a location harder or prevent it.

the-strange.rule.warded-locations.cost_or_limit: Difficulty depends on the ward and location.
the-strange.rule.warded-locations.go_wrong: Failed entry may leave travelers outside or place them in a trap or prison.
the-strange.rule.warded-locations.where_from: Locations protected by magic, technology, cyphers, or other features
the-strange.rule.warded-locations.combines: A ward may channel arrivals to a designated area.
the-strange.rule.warded-locations.blocked_reason: A ward can redirect travel into a specially selected location or holding area.

the-strange.rule.translation-abeyance.name: Translation abeyance

effect.summary: The body left behind disappears and is recreated when the traveler returns.

the-strange.rule.translation-abeyance.cost_or_limit: The returning body and its carried equipment are restored, usually at the place left.
the-strange.rule.translation-abeyance.mind: The character’s consciousness occupies the translated form meanwhile.
the-strange.rule.translation-abeyance.combines: Previous forms and equipment are restored on return.
the-strange.rule.translation-abeyance.mechanism: Suspension and recreation of an abandoned body
the-strange.rule.translation-abeyance.blocked_reason: The rule requires a character’s absent body to persist and later be recreated.

the-strange.rule.noticing-a-translation-.name: Noticing a translation arrival

effect.summary: Spark-bearing or quickened observers can detect arrivals; attentive watchers notice automatically.

the-strange.rule.noticing-a-translation-.cost_or_limit: Otherwise, a visible arrival is a difficulty 2 perception task for PCs.
the-strange.rule.noticing-a-translation-.combines: Long acclimation can make travelers conspicuously out of context.
the-strange.rule.noticing-a-translation-.blocked_reason: Sensing an arrival can be represented by the basic effect grammar.

the-strange.rule.cyphers-and-translation.name: Cyphers and translation

effect.summary: Cyphers usually travel with characters and may change appearance to fit a recursion while retaining their powers.

the-strange.rule.cyphers-and-translation.cost_or_limit: Cyphers are generally the only carried equipment that translates.
the-strange.rule.cyphers-and-translation.combines: Their powers remain unchanged despite a new context-appropriate form.
the-strange.rule.cyphers-and-translation.mechanism: Contextual appearance change with preserved function
the-strange.rule.cyphers-and-translation.blocked_reason: The rule requires carried items to retain their powers while changing form.

the-strange.rule.recursion-keys-do-not-t.name: Recursion keys do not translate

effect.summary: Most recursion keys dissipate when used because they are single-use cyphers.

the-strange.rule.recursion-keys-do-not-t.cost_or_limit: Unusual non-cypher keys can be reused.
the-strange.rule.recursion-keys-do-not-t.go_wrong: A key left behind can let a knowledgeable user follow its route.
the-strange.rule.recursion-keys-do-not-t.combines: Holding a created key allows it to accompany its owner into abeyance.
the-strange.rule.recursion-keys-do-not-t.blocked_reason: The rule makes a used item dissipate and distinguishes reusable variants.

the-strange.rule.crafting-a-recursion-ke.name: Crafting a recursion key

effect.summary: A quickened character can make a key after studying a location and spending time, XP, and effort.

the-strange.rule.crafting-a-recursion-ke.cost_or_limit: Requires a day studying, at least a week crafting, 1 XP, and a successful difficulty check based on recursion level plus two.
the-strange.rule.crafting-a-recursion-ke.go_wrong: Failure permits a retry only by using Effort.
the-strange.rule.crafting-a-recursion-ke.who_may: Quickened characters who have studied the location
the-strange.rule.crafting-a-recursion-ke.combines: The key can take varied physical forms.
the-strange.rule.crafting-a-recursion-ke.blocked_reason: The process can be represented as a crafting task with costs and a difficulty.

the-strange.rule.translation-effects-on-.name: Translation effects on disability, disease, and healing

effect.summary: A new body may change physical disabilities, but translation does not normally cure illness, age, or damage.

the-strange.rule.translation-effects-on-.cost_or_limit: Stats and damage-track position do not change unless a focus says otherwise.
the-strange.rule.translation-effects-on-.go_wrong: A new form can also introduce a disability absent from the old body.
the-strange.rule.translation-effects-on-.mind: Mind control and curses persist unless their required law is absent.
the-strange.rule.translation-effects-on-.where_from: Translation into a new physical form
the-strange.rule.translation-effects-on-.combines: An effect unsupported by the new recursion’s laws fades after a minute and can return elsewhere.
the-strange.rule.translation-effects-on-.mechanism: Selective bodily adaptation and law-dependent effects
the-strange.rule.translation-effects-on-.blocked_reason: The rule changes bodily traits while preserving other conditions and effects.

the-strange.rule.translating-too-often.name: Translating too often

effect.summary: Repeated participation in translation within a day increases task difficulty cumulatively.

the-strange.rule.translating-too-often.cost_or_limit: Each prior initiation, easing, hastening, or helping raises difficulty by one step for the whole group.
the-strange.rule.translating-too-often.go_wrong: Accumulated penalties can make later translations harder.
the-strange.rule.translating-too-often.combines: Penalties from multiple participants and attempts add together.
the-strange.rule.translating-too-often.blocked_reason: A cumulative difficulty modifier can be represented as a task restriction.

the-strange.rule.translation-special-eff.name: Translation special effects

effect.summary: An especially high translation roll removes acclimation and temporarily eases tasks tied to new foci.

the-strange.rule.translation-special-eff.cost_or_limit: A roll of 19 grants the benefit for an hour; a roll of 20 grants it for a day.
the-strange.rule.translation-special-eff.combines: The benefit applies to the translating characters’ new foci.
the-strange.rule.translation-special-eff.blocked_reason: The effect is a temporary task modifier triggered by a roll.

the-strange.rule.recursion-laws.name: Recursion laws

effect.summary: A recursion's governing law determines which kinds of phenomena and artifacts function there.

the-strange.rule.recursion-laws.cost_or_limit: Substandard Physics disallows technology derived from Standard Physics; other laws vary.
the-strange.rule.recursion-laws.combines: Named laws include Standard Physics, Mad Science, Magic, Psionics, Substandard Physics, and Exotic.
the-strange.rule.recursion-laws.blocked_reason: This is a world rule rather than an effect needing additional capabilities.

the-strange.rule.exotic.name: Exotic

effect.summary: A recursion may consist of unusual substances such as living flesh, fire, or dream.

the-strange.rule.exotic.cost_or_limit: Generally unavailable to recursions below level 4.
the-strange.rule.exotic.combines: May describe the substance of the recursion itself.
the-strange.rule.exotic.blocked_reason: The rule allows a world’s fundamental material to take forms outside ordinary materials.

the-strange.rule.reality-seeds.name: Reality seeds

effect.summary: A reality seed contains instructions and parameters that can grow a new recursion when invested in a nexus.

the-strange.rule.reality-seeds.cost_or_limit: Extremely rare; creation also requires a suitable nexus and a successful process.
the-strange.rule.reality-seeds.go_wrong: A seed can be difficult to recognize and is often coveted or guarded.
the-strange.rule.reality-seeds.who_may: Quickened characters can use one to create a recursion.
the-strange.rule.reality-seeds.where_from: The Strange; seeds may condense near existing recursions.
the-strange.rule.reality-seeds.combines: It can change into a context-fitting item when it condenses on a recursion.
the-strange.rule.reality-seeds.blocked_reason: Using a seed creates a new reality with its own world structure and attributes.

the-strange.rule.nexus-requirement-for-i.name: Nexus requirement for investiture

effect.summary: Investing a seed somewhere other than a nexus usually fails.

the-strange.rule.nexus-requirement-for-i.cost_or_limit: A suitable nexus must be found.
the-strange.rule.nexus-requirement-for-i.go_wrong: Investiture away from a nexus usually fails.
the-strange.rule.nexus-requirement-for-i.blocked_reason: A location-based restriction is expressible as a rule.

the-strange.rule.recursion-maturation.name: Recursion maturation

effect.summary: A new recursion gradually develops its designed features through age or creator upkeep.

the-strange.rule.recursion-maturation.cost_or_limit: Development takes time or active improvement.
the-strange.rule.recursion-maturation.go_wrong: Investiture setbacks can prevent normal maturation.
the-strange.rule.recursion-maturation.blocked_reason: Growth over time and through upkeep can be tracked as a rule.

the-strange.rule.investiture-participati.name: Investiture participation and cost

effect.summary: Investiture works best with three to five participants and costs each participant 2 XP, with a 6 XP minimum.

the-strange.rule.investiture-participati.cost_or_limit: Three to five participants; 2 XP each and at least 6 XP total; takes 1d6 hours and uses one seed at a nexus.
the-strange.rule.investiture-participati.combines: One reality seed and a nexus.
the-strange.rule.investiture-participati.blocked_reason: The participation and expenditure are basic procedural costs.

the-strange.rule.investiture-consensus.name: Investiture consensus

effect.summary: Participants must agree on the recursion design; a participant changing their mind during investiture ruins the seed.

the-strange.rule.investiture-consensus.cost_or_limit: All participants must maintain their decision throughout the process.
the-strange.rule.investiture-consensus.go_wrong: A changed mind makes the process fail and destroys the seed.
the-strange.rule.investiture-consensus.mind: A participant’s change of mind has a direct process consequence.
the-strange.rule.investiture-consensus.blocked_reason: The condition and failure consequence are directly trackable.

the-strange.rule.investiture-roll.name: Investiture roll

effect.summary: The investiture roll is an Intellect task at difficulty 5; natural results of 17–20 add 1–4 to a later success-table roll.

the-strange.rule.investiture-roll.cost_or_limit: One participant makes the roll; helpers can assist.
the-strange.rule.investiture-roll.go_wrong: A failed roll leads to a setback result, but the seed remains invested.
the-strange.rule.investiture-roll.who_may: One participant rolls; others may help.
the-strange.rule.investiture-roll.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure rather than a world mechanism.

the-strange.rule.investiture-setback.name: Investiture Setback

effect.summary: A failed investiture roll produces a setback outcome, ranging from arrested growth and ejection risks to colonists or unexpected foci.

the-strange.rule.investiture-setback.go_wrong: The recursion may be stunted, eject visitors, gain inhabitants, or develop unwanted foci.
the-strange.rule.investiture-setback.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure, not a world entity.

the-strange.rule.investiture-success.name: Investiture Success

effect.summary: A success roll sets the number of creator traits and may grant extra size, spaces, or an advanced starting age.

the-strange.rule.investiture-success.cost_or_limit: Results are determined by a d20 roll, with natural-roll bonuses potentially added.
the-strange.rule.investiture-success.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure, not a world entity.

the-strange.rule.seed-planting-location.name: Seed planting location

effect.summary: An invested seed can be planted on a prime world or a recursion connected to one; planting untethered in the Strange doubles maturation age requirements.

the-strange.rule.seed-planting-location.blocked_reason: The location restriction and doubled maturation time are trackable rules.

the-strange.rule.recursion-gate-binding.name: Recursion gate binding

effect.summary: A newly planted pocket dimension is bound within a containing object, with a gate whose mobility follows that object.

the-strange.rule.recursion-gate-binding.cost_or_limit: The containing object is needed only for planting; destroying it destroys the gate, not the recursion.
the-strange.rule.recursion-gate-binding.go_wrong: Destroying the object removes the gate, restricting access to free translation.
the-strange.rule.recursion-gate-binding.combines: Pocket dimension and gate; gate movement follows the bound object.
the-strange.rule.recursion-gate-binding.blocked_reason: Binding a separate dimension inside an object requires spatial storage and gate-access handling.

the-strange.rule.recursion-trait-limit.name: Recursion trait limit

effect.summary: The investiture result limits how many creator traits can be embedded, and active traits may rotate so only one is active at a time.

the-strange.rule.recursion-trait-limit.cost_or_limit: Trait count depends on the investiture result; the usual limit may be fewer than the number of creators.
the-strange.rule.recursion-trait-limit.blocked_reason: Trait switching tied to events or timing needs an activation interaction beyond the basic effect grammar.

the-strange.rule.recursion-age-categorie.name: Recursion age categories

effect.summary: Recursions progress through pocket dimension, young, juvenile, developed, old, and ascendant stages.

the-strange.rule.recursion-age-categorie.cost_or_limit: Age ranges are specified for each stage; many recursions grow a few feet or meters per year.
the-strange.rule.recursion-age-categorie.combines: Recursion size, level, features, gates, and population change with age.
the-strange.rule.recursion-age-categorie.blocked_reason: Progression by age and stage can be represented as a rule.

the-strange.rule.pocket-dimension-limits.name: Pocket dimension limits

effect.summary: A pocket dimension is up to 225 square feet, has maximum level 1, standard physics, one gate, and no spark.

the-strange.rule.pocket-dimension-limits.cost_or_limit: A small open space; draggable foci only and no skills.
the-strange.rule.pocket-dimension-limits.combines: Traits are set by investiture; connected-world playable races.

the-strange.rule.young-recursion-limits.name: Young recursion limits

effect.summary: A young recursion is up to 5,000 square feet, maximum level 2, standard physics, up to two gates, and has no spark.

the-strange.rule.young-recursion-limits.cost_or_limit: Up to fifteen spaces, draggable and one new focus, and no skills.
the-strange.rule.young-recursion-limits.combines: Traits are set by investiture; connected-world playable races.

the-strange.rule.juvenile-recursion-limi.name: Juvenile recursion limits

effect.summary: A juvenile recursion is up to 2 miles across, maximum level 3, and can have one additional law, another playable race, three gates, and 5% spark.

the-strange.rule.juvenile-recursion-limi.cost_or_limit: Up to two new foci; simple skills may appear.

the-strange.rule.developed-recursion-lim.name: Developed recursion limits

effect.summary: A developed recursion is up to 100 miles across, maximum level 5, with up to two additional laws, two other races, various gates, and up to 25% spark.

the-strange.rule.developed-recursion-lim.cost_or_limit: Up to four new foci; complex skills may appear.

the-strange.rule.old-recursion-limits.name: Old recursion limits

effect.summary: An old recursion is up to 1,000 miles across, maximum level 9, with up to two additional laws, five other races, various gates, and up to 80% spark.

the-strange.rule.old-recursion-limits.cost_or_limit: Up to fifteen new foci; complex skills are probable.

the-strange.rule.ascendant-recursion-pot.name: Ascendant recursion potential

effect.summary: An ascendant recursion may develop new qualities and civilizations, diverge greatly from its design, or possibly become a prime world.

the-strange.rule.ascendant-recursion-pot.cost_or_limit: The possibility of becoming a prime world is uncertain.
